    The base stage #

    The stage Y_univ kills the lifts of the αᵢ at all points. Its arrows are the lifts of the arrows of P' = P/⟨αᵢ⟩, and Ψ : FG(P) ⥤ FG(P') (Lemma 2.2) maps it injectively into the universal cover of P' at x₀, arrows to arrows (exists_arr_base). So a good cover of P' makes Y_univ cycle-free and interval-finite. Its simple connectivity comes from the walk-lifting action of FG(P') on the stage (liftActQ), as for the universal cover (sc_univ).
